items.zh: 他點頭表示贊同。
items.ref_en: He indicated approval with a nod.

items.zh: 我深信寫日記的價值。
items.ref_en: I am convinced of the value of keeping a diary.

items.zh: 就交通安全而言，台北大部分駕駛員應該再受教育。
items.ref_en: As far as traffic safety is concerned, most drivers in Taipei should be reeducated.

items.zh: 假如當時受到鼓勵和幫助，他就不會失敗了。
items.ref_en: Given encouragement and help, he would not have failed.

items.zh: 強大的國防是和平與自由最確切的保證。
items.ref_en: A strong national defense is the most certain guarantee of peace and freedom.

items.zh: 運動對健康有益。
items.ref_en: Exercise is good for one's health.

items.zh: 我的腳踏車，上禮拜被偷了。
items.ref_en: My bicycle was stolen last Sunday.

items.zh: 大多數的學生，都不曉得如何使用圖書館。
items.ref_en: Most students do not know how to use a library.

items.zh: 我在今天的報紙上，看到一則很有趣的新聞。
items.ref_en: I read an interesting piece of news in today's newspaper.

items.zh: 要學好英文，必須下功夫。
items.ref_en: If you want to learn English well, you have to work hard.

items.zh: 這一篇文章值得仔細閱讀。
items.ref_en: This article is worth reading carefully.

items.zh: 中國字很難寫嗎？
items.ref_en: Is it very hard to write Chinese characters?

items.zh: 那一位戴黃帽子的外國人是誰？
items.ref_en: Who is the foreigner that is wearing a yellow hat?

items.zh: 天氣一天比一天熱起來了。
items.ref_en: It is getting hotter day by day.

items.zh: 我不是告訴過你，我到車站的時候他們已經走了嗎？
items.ref_en: Haven't I told you that they had already gone when I got to the station?

items.zh: 今天早晨有一位穿綠色制服的人，把信件送到我們的社區來。
items.ref_en: Every morning a man in a green uniform delivers mail to our community.

items.zh: 無論是晴天或下雨，天天都可以看到他。
items.ref_en: Rain or shine, we can see him every day.

items.zh: 如果有掛號信要送給我們，他就會在門口按一下鈴。
items.ref_en: Whenever he has registered letters for us, he will ring the doorbell.

items.zh: 他認識我們附近的每一個人，而我們每一個人也都認識他。
items.ref_en: He knows everyone in our neighborhood, and everyone of us also knows him.

items.zh: 有時候我在上學的途中遇到他，他就以微笑跟我打招呼。
items.ref_en: Sometimes I meet him on my way to school, and he greets me with a smile.

items.zh: 很多學生都不太注意讀書的方法，以至於浪費許多寶貴的時間。
items.ref_en: Many students pay so little attention to reading skills that they waste a lot of precious time.

items.zh: 他們讀英文讀了好幾年，還是看不懂相當容易的文章。
items.ref_en: They have studied English for many years, but they still cannot understand articles which are rather easy.

items.zh: 其實，只要方法正確，英文的閱讀能力並不難培養。
items.ref_en: In fact, as long as the method is correct, English reading ability is not difficult to develop.

items.zh: 在老師還沒有講解課文之前，一定要自己先讀兩三遍。
items.ref_en: Before your teacher explains the text to you, you must go over it two or three times.

items.zh: 不要讀太難的文章，也不要遇到生字就立刻查字典。
items.ref_en: Don't read articles which are too difficult for you and don't look up a new word in a dictionary the moment you see it, either.

items.zh: 英語是一種重要的語言，所以很多人都在學習。
items.ref_en: English is an important language, so many people are learning it.

items.zh: 許多中國學生認為學習說英語很難。
items.ref_en: Many Chinese students think that it is very hard to learn to speak English.

items.zh: 但是只要經常練習，任何困難都可以克服。
items.ref_en: But if you keep practicing speaking English, you can overcome any difficulty.

items.zh: 會背課本上的對話，並不表示會說英語。
items.ref_en: Memorizing the dialogues in the text does not mean that you are able to speak English.

items.zh: 最重要的是，要能用英語說自己想說的話。
items.ref_en: The most important thing is that you should be able to say whatever you want to say in English.

items.zh: 讀小學的時候，我身體很虛弱，並且常感冒。
items.ref_en: When I was in elementary school, I was very weak and often caught colds.

items.zh: 自從上了國中以後，我就儘量找機會運動。
items.ref_en: Ever since I entered junior high school, I have been trying hard to find opportunities for exercise.

items.zh: 雖然功課一直很繁重，我還是每天慢跑半小時。
items.ref_en: Although my schoolwork has been heavy, I have managed to jog for half an hour every day.

items.zh: 六年繼續不斷的鍛鍊使我不但更加強壯，而且也長得更高。
items.ref_en: Six years of constant training has made me not only stronger but also taller.

items.zh: 現在大家都說他們無法相信我從前又矮又瘦。
items.ref_en: Now everyone says that they cannot believe that I was short and thin before.

items.zh: 昨天早上我出門的時候，天氣相當暖和。
items.ref_en: It was quite warm when I left home yesterday morning.

items.zh: 所以我沒有穿毛衣，只穿了一件襯衫。
items.ref_en: Therefore, I didn't wear a sweater but only a shirt.

items.zh: 但是到了下午，溫度卻急速下降了。
items.ref_en: But the temperature dropped sharply in the afternoon.

items.zh: 雖然晚上比往常早回家，我還是覺得有點不舒服。
items.ref_en: Though I got back home earlier than usual in the evening, I still felt slightly under the weather.

items.zh: 今天我不但打噴嚏而且頭痛，我想我最好馬上去看醫生。
items.ref_en: Not only am I sneezing today, but I also have a headache. I think I had better see a doctor right away.

items.zh: 我生長在鄉下的一個小村落。
items.ref_en: I grew up in a small village in the country.

items.zh: 那時，我家附近有一條清澈的小溪。
items.ref_en: At that time, there was a clear brook near the house where I lived.

items.zh: 我夏天常到那裡游泳、釣魚。
items.ref_en: I used to go swimming and fishing there in the summer.

items.zh: 現在溪水髒得連魚都不能活。
items.ref_en: Now the water in the brook has become so filthy that fish cannot live in it.

items.zh: 我不知道甚麼時候才能再見到童年的美景。
items.ref_en: I have no idea when I'll be able to see that beautiful view I remember from my childhood.

items.zh: 老實說，一直到昨天我才知道他已經去美國了。
items.ref_en: To tell the truth, not until yesterday did I know he had gone to the United States.

items.zh: 首先，我要說明清楚，我並不反對你的意見。
items.ref_en: To begin with, I want to make it clear that I don't disagree with your opinion.

items.zh: 這個月，我的運氣真是好得我都不敢相信。
items.ref_en: This month I have been so lucky that I can hardly believe it. (My luck has been so good this month that I can hardly believe it.)

items.zh: 月初，我的數學月考考了九十分。
items.ref_en: Early this month, I received a score of 90 on the monthly math exam. (Early this month, I scored 90 on the monthly math exam.)

items.zh: 月中，父親送我一部電腦當生日禮物。
items.ref_en: In the middle of the month, Father gave me a computer as my birthday gift.

items.zh: 前幾天，英語演講比賽我得了第二名。
items.ref_en: A few days ago, I was placed second in the English speech contest. (A few days ago, I won second place in the English speech contest.)

items.zh: 這輩子，我的運氣從來沒有這麼好過。
items.ref_en: I have never been so lucky in my life.

items.zh: 我弟弟過去經常整日虛混，一件有意義的事也不做。
items.ref_en: My brother used to fool around all day long, not doing anything meaningful.

items.zh: 現在，他努力用功，並且對未來有明確的計劃。
items.ref_en: Now, he is studying very hard; besides, he has a clear plan for the future.

items.zh: 是什麼使得他在行為和態度上有這樣明顯的改變呢？
items.ref_en: What changed him so obviously in his behavior and attitude?

items.zh: 是他的高中老師發現了他的潛力，並且不斷地鼓勵他。
items.ref_en: It was his high school teacher that discovered his potential and kept encouraging him.

items.zh: 弟弟說他會永遠記得並感謝這位老師。
items.ref_en: My younger brother says that he will forever remember and be grateful to his teacher.

items.zh: 台灣的生活最近十年變了很多。
items.ref_en: Life in Taiwan has changed quite a lot over the past ten years.

items.zh: 年輕的一代有許多新的生活方式。
items.ref_en: The younger generation has many new ways of living.

items.zh: 和他們父母親那一輩相當不同。
items.ref_en: Young people are quite different from their parents.

items.zh: 舉個例，很多年輕人喜歡吃美式速食，喝加糖飲料。
items.ref_en: For example, many young people like to eat American fast food and consume sweet drinks.

items.zh: 而老一輩的大多寧可吃中國菜，喝中國茶。
items.ref_en: However, the older generation would rather eat Chinese food and drink tea.

items.zh: 每次放假，我都會到台灣某個地方去旅行。
items.ref_en: Whenever we have a vacation, I'll travel somewhere in Taiwan.

items.zh: 今年春假，我和一些同學搭巴士到墾丁國家公園。
items.ref_en: This spring vacation, I went with some of my classmates by bus to Kenting National Park.

items.zh: 我們在那兒待了三天，很欣賞那裡的山林和海岸。
items.ref_en: We stayed there for three days, appreciating the mountain forests and sea.

items.zh: 這學期還沒結束，可是我們就在計畫夏天的旅行了。
items.ref_en: This semester is not over yet, but we are planning for our summer vacation travels.

items.zh: 我們大概會到台灣東部去，因為那兒風景很美。
items.ref_en: We'll probably go to the east of Taiwan for the scenery there is very beautiful.

items.zh: 我們即將進入二十一世紀。
items.ref_en: We are going into the 21st century.

items.zh: 那時，人們會活得更長久。
items.ref_en: Then, people will live longer.

items.zh: 那的確是個好消息。
items.ref_en: That is nice indeed.

items.zh: 但是會有一個問題：
items.ref_en: But there exists a problem:

items.zh: 更多的老人必須由更少的年輕人奉養。
items.ref_en: There will be more senior citizens to be supported by fewer young people.

items.zh: 以前，我常常到書店去，
items.ref_en: I used to go to the bookstore,

items.zh: 主要是隨便看看一些書。
items.ref_en: mainly to read some books casually.

items.zh: 有時會買一些小說來讀。
items.ref_en: Sometimes I would buy a few novels to read.

items.zh: 現在因為忙著準備考試，
items.ref_en: Now as I am busy preparing for the examination,

items.zh: 再也沒時間去找小說了。
items.ref_en: I can spare no more time to look for some books to read.

items.zh: 年輕人和老年人的睡眠習慣很不相同。
items.ref_en: Young people's sleeping habit is very different from that of old people.

items.zh: 許多年輕人往往很晚還不睡，第二天早上就不能早起。
items.ref_en: Many young people often stay up so late that they can't get up early the next morning.

items.zh: 老年人通常晚上沒事做，所以很早上床。
items.ref_en: Old people usually have nothing to do, so they go to bed early.

items.zh: 這兩種不同的睡眠習慣，哪一種比較有益健康呢？
items.ref_en: Of these two different habits, which is better for health?

items.zh: 其實，只要睡飽，早睡晚睡都沒關係。
items.ref_en: In fact, as long as you get enough sleep, it doesn't matter whether you go to bed early or not.

items.zh: 不關心注意是中止對話的最快速方法之一。
items.ref_en: Not paying attention is one of the fastest ways to stop a conversation.

items.zh: 而是真的聽懂了。
items.ref_en: but you really understand.

items.zh: 他如何在上學途中被狗咬了。
items.ref_en: how he was bitten by a dog on his way to school.

items.zh: 因為他很餓，所以考試考得不好。
items.ref_en: He didn't do well in a test because he was hungry.

items.zh: 聽起來你今天很倒楣。
items.ref_en: Sounds like you really had a bad day. (It sounds like today wasn't your day.) (You seem to have had a really bad day.)

items.zh: 昨天晚上我感覺有點不舒服。
items.ref_en: I didn't feel quite well last night.

items.zh: 我的媽媽要我去看中醫師。
items.ref_en: My mother wanted me to go to the Chinese herbalist.

items.zh: 她說中葯比西葯自然。
items.ref_en: She said that Chinese medicine is more natural than Western medicine.

items.zh: 我生病的時候通常都會去看西醫。
items.ref_en: When I am ill, I usually go to a Western medical doctor.

items.zh: 但是現在我想我有另外的選擇了。
items.ref_en: But now I guess I have another choice.

items.zh: 對於什麼是最佳的渡假方式，大家都有不同的看法。
items.ref_en: Everyone has different opinions about what the best way to spend a vacation is.

items.zh: 有些人喜歡到寧靜的森林中去，在那兒他們可以暫時遠離人群。
items.ref_en: Some people like to go to peaceful forests, where they can get away from the crowds temporarily.

items.zh: 有些人卻寧願到大都市去，因為他們可以參觀博物館或購物。
items.ref_en: Others, however, prefer to go to big cities because they can visit museums or go shopping.

items.zh: 還有一些人喜歡到海邊去，讓海浪沖走他們的煩惱。
items.ref_en: Still others like to go to the beach to let the waves wash away their troubles.

items.zh: 有少數人則決定留在家裡，做一些像打掃屋子之類的事。
items.ref_en: A few people, on the other hand, decide to stay at home and do things like cleaning the house.

items.zh: 昨天在回家的路上，我看到一個小女孩在路邊哭泣。
items.ref_en: On my way home yesterday, I saw a little girl crying by the roadside.

items.zh: 我趕緊跑過去，問她到底發生了什麼事。
items.ref_en: I hurried over to her and asked her what on earth had happened.

items.zh: 小女孩說她按了好幾次門鈴，卻沒有人來開門。
items.ref_en: The little girl said that she had rung the doorbell several times, but nobody came to open the door.

items.zh: 看到她哭得那麼傷心，我就陪她等媽媽回來。
items.ref_en: Seeing her crying so bitterly, I stayed with her and waited for her mother to come back.

items.zh: 雖然晚了半個鐘頭才回到家，我覺得我做了一件有意義的事。
items.ref_en: Although I got home half an hour late, I felt that I had done something meaningful.

items.zh: 有沒有想過未來的旅館會是什麼樣子?
items.ref_en: Have you ever wondered what the hotels of the future will look like?

items.zh: 每個房間附有一部收音機，一台電視機和一個鬧鐘。
items.ref_en: Each room comes with a radio, a television, and an alarm clock.

items.zh: 此外，所有房間都有空調。
items.ref_en: In addition, all the rooms are air-conditioned.

items.zh: 廁所及洗衣設施位於旅館的共同區域。
items.ref_en: The restrooms and laundry facilities are located in the common areas of the hotel.

items.zh: 信不信由你，這家旅館幾乎經常是客滿
items.ref_en: Believe it or not, this hotel is almost always fully booked,

items.zh: 自2007年營運以來，高鐵（the High Speed Rail）已成為臺灣最便利、最快速的交通工具之一。
items.ref_en: Since its operation in 2007, the High Speed Rail has become one of the most convenient and fastest means of transportation in Taiwan.

items.zh: 早期的博物館只開放給中上階層，而且參觀者必須事先申請進入許可。
items.ref_en: The early museums were only open to the upper-middle class, and visitors had to apply for admission in advance.

items.zh: 學習不再侷限於學校內的正規教育，非正式學習已開始扮演重要的角色。
items.ref_en: Learning is no longer confined to formal education in schools; informal learning has begun to play an important role.

items.zh: 例如，志工服務讓學生學到如何與不同背景及不同年齡層的人互動。
items.ref_en: For example, volunteer service allows students to learn how to interact with people from different backgrounds and age groups.

items.zh: 很多人害怕公開演講，常在上台之前發抖、覺得頭昏。
items.ref_en: Many people are afraid of public speaking, often trembling and feeling dizzy before going on stage.

items.zh: 只要我們對自己有信心，並持續練習，就可以克服怯場的問題。
items.ref_en: As long as we have confidence in ourselves and keep practicing, we can overcome the problem of stage fright.

items.zh: 現在越來越多高中英文老師已經增加在課堂上使用英文的百分比。
items.ref_en: Now, more and more senior high school English teachers have increased the percentage of English use in class.

items.zh: 他們將學生依英語能力分成不同組別，進行多樣的聽、說活動。
items.ref_en: They divide students into different groups based on their English ability and conduct various listening and speaking activities.

items.zh: 雖然 Lily 生來又瞎又聾，但她從來不氣餒。
items.ref_en: Although Lily was born both blind and deaf, she has never been discouraged.

items.zh: 她的故事證明了，我們只要努力必能成功。
items.ref_en: Her story proves that we can succeed if we put in effort.

items.zh: 科技讓我們的生活更舒適，然而它也被利用來犯罪。
items.ref_en: Although technology can make our lives more comfortable, it can also be used to commit crimes.

items.zh: 根據最近的新聞報導，最常見的例子是網際網路詐財(Internet scams)。
items.ref_en: According to the latest news report(s), the most common example is Internet scams.

items.zh: 你的性格決定你將會與誰相愛。
items.ref_en: Your personality determines who you will fall in love with.

items.zh: 這個學校不但提供實用課程，也聘用好的老師。
items.ref_en: This school not only offers practical courses but also employs good teachers.

items.zh: 關渡（Guandu）位於台灣的西北部，是觀賞鳥類最佳的地點之一。
items.ref_en: Located in Northwestern Taiwan, Guandu is one of the best places to observe birds.

items.zh: 在這裡你會看到不同的鳥類，有些甚至是在台灣極為罕見的。
items.ref_en: You can see a variety of birds here; some of them are rarely seen in Taiwan.

items.zh: 人類對外太空所知非常有限，但長久以來我們對它卻很感興趣。
items.ref_en: Humans know very little about outer space, but we have long been fascinated by it.

items.zh: 太空科技的快速發展，使我們得以探索它的奧秘。
items.ref_en: The rapid development of space technology allows us to explore its mysteries.

items.zh: 身為地球村的成員，我們不應把自己侷限在這個小島上。
items.ref_en: As members of the global village, we should not confine ourselves to this small island.

items.zh: 我們不但應該參與國際性的活動，並且應該展現我們自己的文化特色。
items.ref_en: We should not only participate in international affairs but also exhibit our distinctive cultural characteristics.

items.zh: 蚵仔煎（oyster omelets）是在每個夜市都找得到的本地食物。
items.ref_en: Oyster omelets are a local food found in every night market.

items.zh: 其味道取決於蚵仔的品質：蚵仔越新鮮蚵仔煎越好吃。
items.ref_en: Their taste depends on the quality of the oysters: the fresher the oysters, the better the omelet.

items.zh: 一般人都知道閱讀對孩子有益。
items.ref_en: Most people know that reading is beneficial for children.

items.zh: 老師應該多鼓勵學生到圖書館借書。
items.ref_en: Teachers should encourage students to borrow books from the library more often.

items.zh: 為提供一個無煙的用餐環境，許多餐廳不允許室內抽煙。
items.ref_en: In order to provide a dining environment free from cigarette smoke, many restaurants have banned smoking.

items.zh: 雖然遭到許多癮君子的反對，這對不抽煙的人的確是一大福音。
items.ref_en: Although many regular smokers oppose the ban, it is good news for people who don't smoke.

items.zh: 如果我們只為自己而活，就不會真正地感到快樂。
items.ref_en: If we live only for ourselves, we will not truly feel happy.

items.zh: 當我們開始為他人著想，快樂之門自然會開啟。
items.ref_en: When we start to think of others, the door to happiness will naturally open.

items.zh: 大眾運輸的快速發展已逐漸縮短了都市和鄉村的距離。
items.ref_en: The rapid development of mass transportation has gradually shortened the distance between the city and the countryside.

items.zh: 有了高速鐵路，我們可以在半天內往返台灣南北兩地。
items.ref_en: With high-speed rail, we can travel from northern Taiwan to southern Taiwan and back within half a day.

items.zh: 聽音樂是一個你可以終生享受的嗜好。
items.ref_en: Listening to music is a hobby you can enjoy for a lifetime.

items.zh: 但能彈奏樂器可以為你帶來更多的喜悅。
items.ref_en: But being able to play an instrument can bring you even more joy.

items.zh: 全球糧食危機已經在世界許多地區造成嚴重的社會問題。
